title: verdict.lock — pinned repo lens packs
description: The repo layer's pin file at .verdict/verdict.lock: strict JSON with exactly one row per pack vendored under .verdict/packs/, sorted by name. The lock covers only the repo layer — the built-in pack is pinned by the binary and org packs live in per-operator settings. source is dir:<path as given> or git:<allowlisted url>@<40-hex sha>; hash is the pack's canonical tree hash; sig is sha256 over name, source, version, and hash, so a hand edit is caught. fetch, post, and record refuse pack-lock-missing or pack-lock-drift from the trusted-base snapshot, and the file joins the controls inventory so an edited snapshot copy refuses controls-stale.

packs.description: One pinned pack row per vendored repo pack, sorted by name.

pack.description: One pinned pack: its manifest identity, where it was vendored from, the canonical tree hash, and an integrity digest over those fields.

name.description: Manifest pack identity as <namespace>/<slug>; the vendored directory is the slug.

source.description: dir:<path as given on the add command line> or git:<url>@<resolved 40-hex HEAD sha>. A dir: payload is a slash path with no control character, backslash, or leading "-". A git: URL is exactly https://host/path with no userinfo, ssh://user@host/path, or user@host:path, with a DNS, IPv4, or bracketed IPv6 host, a path with no control character, whitespace, "?", "#", or leading "-", and only the bare [A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64} ssh user; the scheme is stored lower-case, so an upper-case row refuses.

version.description: Pinned pack semver, as the manifest declares it.

hash.description: The pack's canonical tree hash: sha256 over sorted slash paths, each fed as `== <path-length>:<path> ==`, the body's byte length, the body's bytes, then a newline.

sig.description: sha256 over the entry's name, source, version, and hash in that order, one `key=value` line each. Integrity only: a hand edit breaks it; it is not a signature.
